payload.rationale: This document is a new sprint retro (2026-09-08) that directly extends the prior Sprint 4 Retro (2026-03-22). The three claims — async decision widget shipped, 23-point velocity, Zephyr as key unlock — map onto Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, Position_Sprint4ThesisProven, Obs_TinaVelocity, and the style observations (direct quotes, metric anchoring) that characterize how sprint retros are recorded. The broader positioning and problem narratives (AntiSlackPositioning, DecisionsEvaporate, DecisionCaptureAtConsensus, CoreFeatureDecisionCapture, AntiPatternRealtimeChat) provide the thesis context the widget validates. Same-sprint positions (ContextPreservationNextSprint, PricingTier25Plus, PricingTwelveDollars, WebhookArchitecture, ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform, TargetMarketRemoteTeams) are included because a new retro could update or extend any of them — pricing, architecture, next-sprint focus, and market positioning all evolve quarter over quarter. No area was deliberately excluded; the graph is small and every load-bearing node plausibly overlaps this document.
